title: compact-hero-accordion-steps-visual-refresh
creator: Priya Patel
description: Refresh the Quickstart landing visual language with a compact hero and a new interactive accordion-style steps module optimized for engineers discovering Redwood. Goals: reduce initial vertical scroll on small screens, surface a short live sample callout, introduce an animated cost/latency token indicator, and produce device-ready screenshots for docs and marketing. Deliverables: hero art (SVG + Lottie), three step illustrations (compact icons + microcopy variants), interactive accordion prototype (Figma + HTML/CSS snippets), screenshot set (desktop, tablet, mobile) with staged API call and Console route overlays, and handoff package for frontend engineers.
acceptance_criteria: Hero art exported as responsive SVG and Lottie with a 16:9 and 4:3 safe-area variant
Accordion steps prototype in Figma with interactive states and annotated token counts
Mobile-first layout reduces hero height by at least 30% vs current baseline while keeping CTA visible on first fold
Three screenshot variants (desktop @1200x800, tablet @900x600, mobile @420x780) with production-like sample payloads
A11y checks: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for text, keyboard operable accordion, aria labels documented
Handoff zip includes redlines, export tokens, font stacks, asset names, and a short integration guide for Console routes
